verdict.rationale: Recurly documents webhook support for real-time subscription events (recurly-docs-31) and separately notes webhook notifications tied to credit invoices (recurly-docs-22), confirming the capability exists and is API/integration-oriented, fitting an AI-native automation workflow. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on event catalog, payload schemas, retry/security (signing) mechanics, or independent developer corroboration of webhook reliability. Missing for 10: comprehensive event-type documentation, webhook security/signing details, and independent/hands-on validation of webhook delivery.
